name: pos-instrument-replay-m4-analyzer
title: POS campaign M4: offline three-state H1-H4 analyzer (analyze-batch.mjs)
description: M4 (final milestone) of the proof-or-stop evidence-instrument replay campaign: a PURELY OFFLINE analyzer analyze-batch.mjs that reads the four already-produced evidence streams — batch-ledger.jsonl (H1 replay determinism + H4 scale envelope), tamper-verdicts.jsonl (H2 tamper fail-closed), resume-reconciliation.json (H3 resume integrity) — plus the frozen protocol.json, and adjudicates each hypothesis H1/H2/H3/H4 into a THREE-STATE verdict (pass | fail | inconclusive). It emits report.json + report.md with a REPRODUCIBLE digest (sha256 of the canonical report minus the digest field); re-running on the same inputs yields a byte-identical report + digest. The analyzer NEVER re-executes the instrument and NEVER calls the lattice CLI — it only reads committed evidence. A hermetic selfcheck-m4.mjs asserts the three-state derivation is correct and un-gameable (tampered/missing/insufficient evidence -> inconclusive or fail, never a false pass), and a genuine Codex cross-host pass replicates the report digest independently.
